site.title: {project} - Partaz Fisye Desantralize
site.description: {project} i en lozisyel peer-to-peer pour partaz fisye, konstrir lo teknolozi modern desantralize.
site.ogDescription: Partaz fisye peer-to-peer lo teknolozi modern desantralize. Pa en server santral. Pa en sel pwen defayans.

hero.subtitle: Prosen zenerasyon partaz fisye peer-to-peer
hero.description: Lo teknolozi modern desantralize. Pa en server santral. Pa en sel pwen defayans.

about.title: Lo
about.intro: {project} i en platform prosen zenerasyon pour partaz fisye peer-to-peer ki konstrir lo teknolozi modern desantralize. I konbin en lentefas fasil pour servi avek en larsitektir antyerman desantralize, ofer partaz done san danze e fyab san bezwen okenn lotorite santral. Sa proze i open source, distribye anba {license}.

decentralized.title: Rezo antyerman desantralize
decentralized.description: Pa en server santral, pa en sel pwen defayans. Bann itilizater i dekouver e telesarz konteni direkteman ant zot menm, san depan lo okenn lendekser, traker, oubyen baz done santral.

accessControl.title: Kontrol akse fin
accessControl.description: Nenport ki kapab lans son prop rezo gratuitman avek son prop bann regleman. Dan sak rezo, defini bann rol bann itilizater: propriyeter, admin, edidite, moderater e telesarzer. Kontrol fin lekel ki kapab edidite, moder e telesarz konteni.

ui.title: Lentefas itilizater otkalite
ui.description: Lentefas santenmedya prop e flwid, dizenny pour desktop, TV e platform mobil. Navigasyon fasil avek klavye, sourit, gamepad oubyen telekomann. Itilizater avanse i kapab fer lozisyel mars konman en serve fisye san en latet atraver lentefas linny komann.

dataFormat.title: Format done lizibl pour limen
dataFormat.description: Format done LISH i konstrir lo JSON, ki fer i fasil pour kre, li e konpran. Partaz ou konteni avek metadata kler e transparan ki nenport ki kapab enspekte fasilman.

security.title: Konfidansyalite e sekirite
security.description: Tou kominikasyon peer-to-peer in kripte, garanti ki ou done i reste prive pandan transmisyon. Bann itilizater i kapab kasyet deryer en VPN pour en kous adisyonel lanonimite. {project} i respekte ou konfidansyalite par dizenny.

crossPlatform.title: Miltiplatform
crossPlatform.description: Lozisyel i disponib lo Windows, Linux e macOS. Servi li lo nenport ki aparey ou prefere.

download.title: Telesarz
download.description: Gany {project} pour ou platform. Tou bann telesarzman i gratui e open source.

macos.title: Not enportan pour itilizater macOS:
macos.intro: macOS Gatekeeper pou blok bann aplikasyon non sinyen/notarize ki ti telesarze depi lentenet, avek lerer {error}.
macos.runCommand: Apre ou telesarz DMG oubyen ZIP, avan ou ouver aplikasyon, fer mars sa komann dan Terminal:
macos.explanation: Sa pou retir atribi karantin e les aplikasyon mars.
